title: validate after finished interacting
rule: Validate after the merchant finished interacting (not before). Overlap NN/g §7; Polar names it on the component.
pass_when: Validation runs after interaction with the field finishes, not while it is still being completed.
fail_when: Error shown before the merchant finished interacting.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Deleting `forms.errors.inline_after_complete`; this is the Polar-named component row. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.errors.inline_after_complete` (NN/g §7). Keep the named row; do not re-dump §7.
